verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ רִיבָ֣ה יְרִיבַ֑י יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ לְ֝חַ֗ם אֶת־ לֹֽחֲמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ rî·ḇāh yə·rî·ḇay Yah·weh ’eṯ- lə·ḥam ’eṯ- lō·ḥă·māy
verses.literal: Of David Contend with my opponents O LORD . . . fight against those . . . who fight against me

verses.original: הַחֲזֵ֣ק מָגֵ֣ן וְצִנָּ֑ה וְ֝ק֗וּמָה בְּעֶזְרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥă·zêq mā·ḡên wə·ṣin·nāh wə·qū·māh bə·‘ez·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Take up Your shield and buckler arise and come to my aid

verses.original: וְהָ֘רֵ֤ק חֲנִ֣ית וּ֭סְגֹר לִקְרַ֣את רֹדְפָ֑י אֱמֹ֥ר לְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אָֽנִי׃ יְֽשֻׁעָתֵ֥ךְ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rêq ḥă·nîṯ ū·sə·ḡōr liq·raṯ rō·ḏə·p̄āy ’ĕ·mōr lə·nap̄·šî ’ā·nî yə·šu·‘ā·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers say to my soul I [am] your salvation

verses.original: מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ֮ חֹ֝שְׁבֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃ יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֣וֹר וְיַחְפְּר֑וּ
verses.transliteration: mə·ḇaq·šê nap̄·šî yê·ḇō·šū wə·yik·kā·lə·mū ḥō·šə·ḇê rā·‘ā·ṯî yis·sō·ḡū ’ā·ḥō·wr wə·yaḥ·pə·rū
verses.literal: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame may those who plan to harm me be driven back . . . and confounded

verses.original: יִֽהְי֗וּ כְּמֹ֥ץ לִפְנֵי־ ר֑וּחַ וּמַלְאַ֖ךְ יְהוָ֣ה דּוֹחֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yih·yū kə·mōṣ lip̄·nê- rū·aḥ ū·mal·’aḵ Yah·weh dō·w·ḥeh
verses.literal: May they be like chaff in the wind as the angel of the LORD drives them away

verses.original: דַרְכָּ֗ם יְֽהִי־ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקּ֑וֹת וּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְ֝הוָ֗ה רֹדְפָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḏar·kām yə·hî- ḥō·šeḵ wa·ḥă·laq·laq·qō·wṯ ū·mal·’aḵ Yah·weh rō·ḏə·p̄ām
verses.literal: May their path be dark and slick as the angel of the LORD pursues

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חִנָּ֣ם טָֽמְנוּ־ רִשְׁתָּ֑ם לִ֭י חִ֝נָּ֗ם חָפְר֥וּ שַׁ֣חַת לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥin·nām ṭā·mə·nū- riš·tām lî ḥin·nām ḥā·p̄ə·rū ša·ḥaṯ lə·nap̄·šî
verses.literal: For without cause they laid their net for me without reason they dug a pit for my soul

verses.original: שׁוֹאָה֮ תְּבוֹאֵ֣הוּ לֹֽא־ יֵ֫דָ֥ע וְרִשְׁתּ֣וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ טָמַ֣ן תִּלְכְּד֑וֹ יִפָּל־ בָּֽהּ׃ בְּ֝שׁוֹאָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: šō·w·’āh tə·ḇō·w·’ê·hū lō- yê·ḏā‘ wə·riš·tōw ’ă·šer- ṭā·man til·kə·ḏōw yip·pāl- bāh bə·šō·w·’āh
verses.literal: May ruin befall them by surprise . . . may the net - they hid ensnare them may they fall into the hazard [they created]

verses.original: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי תָּגִ֣יל בַּיהוָ֑ה תָּ֝שִׂישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nap̄·šî tā·ḡîl Yah·weh tā·śîś bî·šū·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation

verses.original: כָּ֥ל עַצְמוֹתַ֨י׀ תֹּאמַרְנָה֮ מִ֥י כָ֫מ֥וֹךָ יְהוָ֗ה מַצִּ֣יל עָ֭נִי מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מֵחָזָ֣ק וְעָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן מִגֹּזְלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯay tō·mar·nāh mî ḵā·mō·w·ḵā Yah·weh maṣ·ṣîl ‘ā·nî mim·men·nū mê·ḥā·zāq wə·‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn mig·gō·zə·lōw
verses.literal: All my bones will exclaim Who is like You O LORD who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor the poor and needy from the robber

verses.original: חָמָ֑ס עֵדֵ֣י יְ֭קוּמוּן יִשְׁאָלֽוּנִי׃ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי לֹא־
verses.transliteration: ḥā·mās ‘ê·ḏê yə·qū·mūn yiš·’ā·lū·nî ’ă·šer yā·ḏa‘·tî lō-
verses.literal: Hostile witnesses come forward they make charges - I know nothing {about}

verses.original: יְשַׁלְּמ֣וּנִי רָ֭עָה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָ֗ה שְׁכ֣וֹל לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: yə·šal·lə·mū·nî rā·‘āh ta·ḥaṯ ṭō·w·ḇāh šə·ḵō·wl lə·nap̄·šî
verses.literal: They repay me evil for good [to] the bereavement of my soul

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ בַּחֲלוֹתָ֡ם לְב֬וּשִׁי שָׂ֗ק עִנֵּ֣יתִי נַפְשִׁ֑י בַצּ֣וֹם וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י תָשֽׁוּב׃ עַל־ חֵיקִ֥י
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ba·ḥă·lō·w·ṯām lə·ḇū·šî śāq ‘in·nê·ṯî nap̄·šî ḇaṣ·ṣō·wm ū·ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî ṯā·šūḇ ‘al- ḥê·qî
verses.literal: Yet when they were ill I put on sackcloth I humbled myself with fasting but my prayers returned unanswered . . .

verses.original: הִתְהַלָּ֑כְתִּי כְּרֵֽעַ־ כְּאָ֣ח לִ֭י שַׁחֽוֹתִי׃ קֹדֵ֥ר כַּאֲבֶל־ אֵ֝֗ם
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·hal·lā·ḵə·tî kə·rê·a‘- kə·’āḥ lî ša·ḥō·w·ṯî qō·ḏêr ka·’ă·ḇel- ’êm
verses.literal: I paced about as for my friend or brother I was bowed down with grief like one mourning [for his] mother

verses.original: וּבְצַלְעִי֮ וְֽנֶאֱ֫סָ֥פוּ שָׂמְח֪וּ נֶאֶסְפ֬וּ עָלַ֣י נֵ֭כִים וְלֹ֣א יָדַ֑עְתִּי קָֽרְע֥וּ וְלֹא־ דָֽמּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ṣal·‘î wə·ne·’ĕ·sā·p̄ū śā·mə·ḥū ne·’es·p̄ū ‘ā·lay nê·ḵîm wə·lō yā·ḏa‘·tî qā·rə·‘ū wə·lō- ḏām·mū
verses.literal: But when I stumbled they assembled in glee they gathered together against me Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing

verses.original: בְּ֭חַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵ֣י מָע֑וֹג חָרֹ֖ק שִׁנֵּֽימוֹ׃ עָלַ֣י
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥan·p̄ê la·‘ă·ḡê mā·‘ō·wḡ ḥā·rōq šin·nê·mōw ‘ā·lay
verses.literal: Like godless jesters at a feast they gnashed their teeth at me

verses.original: כַּמָּ֪ה אֲדֹנָי֮ תִּ֫רְאֶ֥ה הָשִׁ֣יבָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶ֑ם יְחִידָתִֽי׃ מִ֝כְּפִירִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: kam·māh ’ă·ḏō·nāy tir·’eh hā·šî·ḇāh nap̄·šî miš·šō·’ê·hem yə·ḥî·ḏā·ṯî mik·kə·p̄î·rîm
verses.literal: How long O Lord will You look on Rescue my soul from their ravages my precious life from these lions

verses.original: א֭וֹדְךָ רָ֑ב בְּקָהָ֣ל אֲהַֽלְלֶֽךָּ׃ עָצ֣וּם בְּעַ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ’ō·wḏ·ḵā rāḇ bə·qā·hāl ’ă·hal·le·kā ‘ā·ṣūm bə·‘am
verses.literal: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly I will praise You among many people

verses.original: אַֽל־ אֹיְבַ֣י יִשְׂמְחוּ־ לִ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר שֹׂנְאַ֥י חִ֝נָּ֗ם יִקְרְצוּ־ עָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- ’ō·yə·ḇay yiś·mə·ḥū- lî še·qer śō·nə·’ay ḥin·nām yiq·rə·ṣū- ‘ā·yin
verses.literal: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause [nor] those who hate me without reason wink in malice . . .

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֥א יְדַ֫בֵּ֥רוּ שָׁל֗וֹם יַחֲשֹׁבֽוּן׃ מִ֝רְמוֹת דִּבְרֵ֥י וְעַ֥ל רִגְעֵי־ אֶ֑רֶץ
verses.transliteration: kî lō yə·ḏab·bê·rū šā·lō·wm ya·ḥă·šō·ḇūn mir·mō·wṯ diḇ·rê wə·‘al riḡ·‘ê- ’e·reṣ
verses.literal: For they do not speak peace but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land

verses.original: פִּ֫יהֶ֥ם וַיַּרְחִ֥יבוּ עָלַ֗י אָ֭מְרוּ הֶאָ֣ח׀ הֶאָ֑ח עֵינֵֽינוּ׃ רָאֲתָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: pî·hem way·yar·ḥî·ḇū ‘ā·lay ’ā·mə·rū he·’āḥ he·’āḥ ‘ê·nê·nū rā·’ă·ṯāh
verses.literal: They gape . . . at me and say Aha aha Our eyes have seen

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה רָאִ֣יתָה אַֽל־ תֶּחֱרַ֑שׁ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אֲל־ תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh rā·’î·ṯāh ’al- te·ḥĕ·raš ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ăl- tir·ḥaq mim·men·nî
verses.literal: O LORD You have seen it be not silent O Lord be not far from me

verses.original: הָעִ֣ירָה וְ֭הָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִ֑י לְרִיבִֽי׃ אֱלֹהַ֖י וַֽאדֹנָ֣י
verses.transliteration: hā·‘î·rāh wə·hā·qî·ṣāh lə·miš·pā·ṭî lə·rî·ḇî ’ĕ·lō·hay wa·ḏō·nāy
verses.literal: Awake and rise to my defense to my cause my God and my Lord

verses.original: שָׁפְטֵ֣נִי כְ֭צִדְקְךָ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֗י וְאַל־ יִשְׂמְחוּ־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šā·p̄ə·ṭê·nî ḵə·ṣiḏ·qə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy wə·’al- yiś·mə·ḥū- lî
verses.literal: Vindicate me by Your righteousness O LORD my God and do not let them gloat over me

verses.original: אַל־ יֹאמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם הֶאָ֣ח נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ אַל־ יֹ֝אמְר֗וּ בִּֽלַּעֲנֽוּהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yō·mə·rū ḇə·lib·bām he·’āḥ nap̄·šê·nū ’al- yō·mə·rū bil·la·‘ă·nū·hū
verses.literal: Let them not say in their hearts Aha just what we wanted Let them not say We have swallowed him up

verses.original: שְׂמֵחֵ֪י רָעָ֫תִ֥י יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ׀ יַחְדָּו֮ הַֽמַּגְדִּילִ֥ים עָלָֽי׃ יִֽלְבְּשׁוּ־ בֹ֥שֶׁת וּכְלִמָּ֑ה
verses.transliteration: śə·mê·ḥê rā·‘ā·ṯî yê·ḇō·šū wə·yaḥ·pə·rū yaḥ·dāw ham·maḡ·dî·lîm ‘ā·lāy yil·bə·šū- ḇō·šeṯ ū·ḵə·lim·māh
verses.literal: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded . . . may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach

verses.original: חֲפֵצֵ֪י צִ֫דְקִ֥י יָרֹ֣נּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ֮ תָ֭מִיד וְיֹאמְר֣וּ יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה הֶ֝חָפֵ֗ץ עַבְדּֽוֹ׃ שְׁל֣וֹם
verses.transliteration: ḥă·p̄ê·ṣê ṣiḏ·qî yā·rōn·nū wə·yiś·mə·ḥū ṯā·mîḏ wə·yō·mə·rū yiḡ·dal Yah·weh he·ḥā·p̄êṣ ‘aḇ·dōw šə·lō·wm
verses.literal: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness may they always say Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being

verses.original: וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקֶ֑ךָ תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃ כָּל־ הַ֝יּוֹם
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·šō·w·nî teh·geh ṣiḏ·qe·ḵā tə·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness [and] Your praises all day long
